column_description: TEXT. Unique identifier for scan session record. PK = Scans(QuestRegistry). Example: ASD409481.
TEXT. Precise timestamp when scan was performed. Example: 2024-09-03 07:20:28.479288 GMT+8.
TEXT. Reference to associated archeologys project. FK to Projects.
TEXT. Reference to operator who performed the scan. FK to Personnel.
TEXT. Reference to site where scan was conducted. FK to Sites.
TEXT. Total number of individual scans in session. Example: 5 scans, moderate coverage session.
TEXT. Weather conditions during scanning session. **NULL means weather conditions not recorded or monitoring equipment unavailable.**. Example: Windy conditions, potential equipment stability issues.
TEXT. Color capture mode or settings used during scan. **NULL means color capture not enabled or settings not recorded.**. Possible values: Grayscale, RGB.
TEXT. File format used for storing scan data. Example: PTS.
TEXT. Total file size of scan data in gigabytes. Example: 24.71 GB.
TEXT. Equipment cost per GB. Example: 3.22 USD/GB.
TEXT. Data acquisition rate during scanning. Example: 63 MB/min.
